title_sq: Shitet apartament 2+1,ne zonen e Shkozes prane Elite Palase.
description_sq:
Shitet apartament 2+1,ne zonen e Shkozes prane Elite Palase.
Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 4-te te nje pallati te ri.
Me nje siperfaqe totale 93m2 dhe siperfaqe neto 91.3m2,apartamenti organizohet ne korridor shperndares,sallon dhe ambient gatimi,
2 dhoma gjumi,1 tualet me dritare,1 ne dhomen matrimoniale.
Apartamenti ka orientim lindje me pamje nga mali i Dajtit.
Shitet i mobiluar totalisht me cdo gje funksionale si ne foto.
Cmimi i shitjes 135 milion Leke
title_en: 2+1 apartment for sale, in the area of ​​Shkoza, near Elite Palace.
description_en: 2+1 apartment for sale, in the area of ​​Shkoza, near Elite Palace. The apartment is located on the 4th floor of a new building. With a total area of ​​93m2 and a net area of ​​91.3m2, the apartment is organized in a distribution corridor, living room and kitchen area, 2 bedrooms, 1 bathroom with window, 1 in the matrimonial room. The apartment has an east orientation with a view of Dajti mountain. It is sold fully furnished with everything functional as in the photo. Sale price 135 million Lek
